claims_rejected.why: ஊன்கொண்ட காட்சி முதலாக உடைத்தது எல்லாம் யான்கண்ட வாறே உரைப்பன் announces the views to be broken; a statement of contents, not a doctrine stated

claims.gist: former deeds (ஊழ்வினை துரப்ப) drove Kovalan to Madurai and his death

claims_rejected.why: the Sibi and Manu Needhi Cholan exempla of just kingship are recalled as Puhar's glory, illustrated not stated as a rule

units.note: ஊழ்வினை is said of one case in Kannaki's mouth; counted as a stated claim, though it could be read as narration.

claims_rejected.why: the queen's dream portents (குடையொடு கோல்வீழ, கதிரை இருள்விழுங்க) foreshadow ruin but no one states a rule of omens

claims.gist: comparison (உவமம், ஒப்புமை அளவை) is a means of knowledge: the gavaya is like the cow
scripture (ஆகம அளவை) is a means of knowledge: from the knower's text one grasps that enjoyment-worlds exist
presumption (அருத்தாபத்தி) is a means of knowledge: a hamlet 'on the Ganga' is understood to be on its bank
natural fitness (இயல்பு) is a means of knowledge: one on an elephant asking for a goad is given that and nothing else
tradition (ஐதிகம்) is a means of knowledge: common report that a ghost lives in this tree
non-existence (அபாவம்) is a means of knowledge: knowing a thing is absent from a place
implication (மீட்சி) is a means of knowledge: 'Rama won' gives that Ravana lost
inclusion (உள்ள நெறி) is a means of knowledge: where an iron rod moves, a magnet is to be inferred

claims_rejected.why: போக புவனம் உண்டு is the example inside the definition of ஆகமம், not a separate claim the speaker argues

units.note: Manimekalai hears this school without answering it in this kaathai (line 278, நான் மாறு உரைக்கிலேன்), so stance is reported, not refuted.

claims_rejected.why: கடவுள் புகல் நீக்குதல் காரணமா gives the demoness's motive in the story; narrated action, no doctrine stated

claims.gist: God (இறைவன் ஈசன்) has eight forms: sun and moon, the sacrificer and the five elements
God binds soul to body (உயிரும் யாக்கையும் கட்டி நிற்போன்)
God creates in play, destroys, and removes suffering, and there is nothing other than him (தன்னில் வேறு தான் ஒன்று இலோன்)

claims_rejected.why: பரசும் நின் தெய்வம் எப்படித்து is Manimekalai's question, not a claim

claims.gist: the paths she has heard are not good (நன்று அல), though she will not rebut them now
memory of a former birth is only the altered mind of the possessed or the dreaming (தெய்வ மயக்கினும் கனா உறு திறத்தினும்)

claims_rejected.why: பிறந்த முன் பிறப்பை ... அறிந்தோர் உண்டோ implies rebirth and its recollection, but is put as a question, not stated

units.note: The materialist's reply is answered at once (line 283 on, நின் தந்தை தாயரை அனுமானத்தால்), so it is refuted, unlike the schools she declines to answer.

claims_rejected.why: இறைமுறை பிழைத்தோன் is Kannaki's accusation against this king, a particular charge rather than a general ethical claim

units.note: Hard to apply: the charge that the king erred in royal justice is ethical but particular; I did not count it.

claims_rejected.why: the poet says he saw this in a dream after worshipping the Jina's feet (தண்டாமரைமேல் நடந்தான்); an account of the work's origin, not doctrine

claims.gist: primal nature (மூலப் பகுதி) is hard to know, made of three gunas, without mind, and the ground from which all things appear
from primal nature evolve buddhi (மான்), then space, air, fire, water, earth, mind, ego, senses and organs of action, and from the element-evolutes the world
the evolutes return by the way they came and dissolve into it at pralaya; it remains one, all-pervading and eternal

claims_rejected.why: the sense-organ and object correlations are steps within the evolution claim, not separate claims

claims.gist: a thing is both permanent and impermanent: the neem persists as it sprouts, the pulse's nature persists when it is cooked
dharmastikaya pervades everywhere, is eternal, and moves things
adharmastikaya makes all things stay at rest
time is the brief instant and the long kalpa
space gives room to all things
the soul (சீவன்) joins the body and enjoys the senses
the atom, pudgala, makes outer form and performs good and bad deeds
release is stopping the inflow of both good and bad karma and exhausting former karma by experiencing its fruit (அனுபவித்து அறுத்திடுதல் அது வீடு)

claims_rejected.why: நல்வினை தீவினை அவை செயும் is read as part of the pudgala claim; whether pudgala or soul is its subject is unclear

claims.gist: the means of knowledge are perception, inference, comparison, scripture, presumption, fitness, tradition, non-existence, implication and inclusion, and by them the truth of things must be grasped
valid perception is of five kinds, through eye, ear, nose, tongue and body
perception is valid when soul, sense-door and mind are unimpaired and free of error and doubt, and knows place, name, class, quality and action

claims_rejected.why: that Vyasa, Kritakoti and Jaimini taught ten, eight and six pramanas is a report of authorities, not a separate doctrine
